Request with all message role types (system, user, assistant, tool) to verify round-trip serialization

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go/v2"
)

func main() {
	req := pkg.ChatCompletionRequest{
		Model: `gpt-4`,
		Messages: []pkg.Message{
			pkg.Message{Role: `system`, System: &pkg.SystemMessage{
				Content: pkg.UserContent(`You are a helpful assistant.`),
			}},
			pkg.Message{Role: `user`, User: &pkg.UserMessage{
				Content: pkg.UserContent(`What is the weather in Paris?`),
			}},
			pkg.Message{Role: `assistant`, Assistant: &pkg.AssistantMessage{
				ToolCalls: []pkg.ToolCall{
					pkg.ToolCall{
						ID:       `call_xyz789`,
						CallType: pkg.ToolTypeFunction,
						Function: &pkg.FunctionCall{
							Name:      `get_weather`,
							Arguments: `{"location": "Paris, France"}`,
						},
					},
				},
			}},
			pkg.Message{Role: `tool`, Tool: &pkg.ToolMessage{
				Content:    pkg.UserContent(`{"temperature": 18, "unit": "celsius", "description": "Partly cloudy"}`),
				ToolCallID: `call_xyz789`,
			}},
		},
	}
	client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.Chat(req)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Choices)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Choices[0].FinishReason)
}
```
